parsed.summary: Tracing the power, MCU, peripheral and inter-MCU sheets, every component reference, part number, value and rail matches the specification (MIC26903 5 V buck with R5=6k8/R6=1k3 giving ~5 V, LD39200PU33R 3V3 LDO, INA219 on I2C2 at 0x40 across the 10 mΩ R1 shunt, H753VITx FCC + F405RGTx NAVC, PCA9685, W25N01 SPI NAND, 24CW1280 EEPROMs, BMI088/IIS2MDCTR/MPRLS/TMP100/MAX-8Q, CH330 bridges, 25 MHz crystals). The only apparent pin swap (MPRLS RES↔EOC, nets INT_BAR_NAVC/BAR_NRST_NAVC) is the explicitly documented V1 bug and is therefore not an anomaly; the remaining oddities (an unused SN74LVC1G34 stub on the SPI clock net, redundant I2C pull-ups, and INA219/PCA9685 both at 0x40) are either harmless or properties the specification itself endorses, so no deviation from the intended design is supported by the drawing.
